launch-smoke-test.description: Parked: fires once a year at 09:00 on 1 December so it does not run during testing.

valid-cron-check.description: PROD CHECK: identical to the invalid one apart from a real date. Must be created.

skill-outside-repo.description: PROD CHECK EXP-10405: path resolves outside the repo. Must be rejected.

skill-missing-path.description: PROD CHECK EXP-10405: path does not exist at the pushed commit. Must be rejected.

valid-alongside-invalid.description: PROD CHECK: brand new valid entry, created in the same push as two rejected skill paths. Must appear.

impossible-cron.description: PROD CHECK EXP-10424: 30 February. Must be skipped without blocking its siblings.

new-sibling-of-bad-cron.description: PROD CHECK EXP-10424 discriminator: brand new, valid, pushed alongside an impossible cron. Pre-fix this would be blocked; post-fix it must be created.
